input.what: EmbeddingGemma 2 audio soft tokens (get_audio_features pooler_output), 25 per second

architecture.name: b
architecture.kind: EmbeddingGemma 2 text model cut to layers 0..k-1, fine-tuned

logits: scale * cos(vector, table[w]) for w in vocab; blank from blank_logit
decode: greedy argmax over N+1, collapse repeats, drop blank

window.note: encoder is causal; 96 left-overlap tokens and 1 right-extra token dropped per 30s window

weights.format: torch state_dict, float32; trained on 8x TPU (high precision), evaluated in highest (fp32) precision
weights.keys: body.* (reader body), blank.weight [1, 768], blank.bias [1], log_scale (scale = exp(log_scale))
